knowledge:
- key_parameters: organism=The full scientific name of the species (e.g., "Homo sapiens", "Mus musculus") used to filter queries or download archives ;; systemCode=A standardized single- or double-letter code representing the identifier datasource (e.g., 'H' for HGNC, 'L' for Entrez Gene, 'En' for Ensembl, 'Ce' for ChEBI) ;; format=The file format to download from the pathway archive (e.g., "gmt", "gpml", "svg") ;; date=An optional timestamp (e.g., "20171010") to download a specific monthly release for reproducibility
- alternatives: BridgeDbR=Use to programmatically retrieve correct system codes (e.g., BridgeDbR::getSystemCode("Ensembl")) instead of guessing them ;; clusterProfiler::enrichGO=Use for general Gene Ontology (GO) enrichment analysis when pathway-specific mechanisms are not required
- when_to_use: Use when you have a list of differentially expressed genes (or ranked gene expression data) and want to identify over-represented biological pathways, visualize these pathways with data overlays, or extend them with drug-target/regulatory interactions in Cytoscape.
- pitfalls: Using length() on Xref query results can be misleading because a pathway will be listed multiple times if the query Xref is present multiple times in it ;; Identifier mismatch: clusterProfiler functions expect Entrez IDs, whereas input datasets may use Ensembl IDs or Gene Symbols; use clusterProfiler::bitr to convert ;; Cytoscape connection: Ensure Cytoscape is running and the WikiPathways app is installed before calling RCy3 or commandsRun functions, otherwise connection/import commands will fail ;; Saving paths: If a complete path is not specified in saveSession(), files are saved relative to the Cytoscape installation directory, which may lack write permissions.

workflows.name: pathway_over_representation_analysis_and_visualization
workflows.intent: Perform pathway over-representation analysis on differential gene expression data, import the top enriched pathways into Cytoscape, overlay expression data, and extend the pathway network with drug-target interactions.
input: data-lung-cancer.csv (differential gene expression dataset containing Ensembl IDs, log2 fold changes, and p-values)
workflows.stages:
1. Load differential expression data and define up- and down-regulated gene sets.
2. Convert gene identifiers (Ensembl to Entrez) using clusterProfiler::bitr.
3. Perform pathway enrichment analysis (Over-representation Analysis) using clusterProfiler::enrichWP.
4. Search and explore relevant pathways using rWikiPathways text search functions.
5. Import enriched pathways into Cytoscape using RCy3::commandsRun with the WikiPathways app.
6. Overlay log2 fold change data onto the imported pathways using loadTableData and setNodeColorMapping.
7. Import the pathway as a network and extend it with drug-target interactions using CyTargetLinker.
8. Customize the visualization of added drug nodes and export the final network image.
workflows.code:
lung.expr <- read.csv(system.file("extdata","data-lung-cancer.csv", package="rWikiPathways"),stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
up.genes <- lung.expr[lung.expr$log2FC > 1 & lung.expr$adj.P.Value < 0.05, 1]
dn.genes <- lung.expr[lung.expr$log2FC < -1 & lung.expr$adj.P.Value < 0.05, 1]
bkgd.genes <- lung.expr[,1]
up.genes.entrez <- clusterProfiler::bitr(up.genes,fromType = "ENSEMBL",toType = "ENTREZID",OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)
dn.genes.entrez <- bitr(dn.genes,fromType = "ENSEMBL",toType = "ENTREZID",OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)
bkgd.genes.entrez <- bitr(bkgd.genes,fromType = "ENSEMBL",toType = "ENTREZID",OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)
ewp.up <- clusterProfiler::enrichWP(
  up.genes.entrez[[2]],
  universe = bkgd.genes.entrez[[2]],
  organism = "Homo sapiens",
  pAdjustMethod = "fdr",
  pvalueCutoff = 0.1, #p.adjust cutoff; relaxed for demo purposes
)
ewp.up <- DOSE::setReadable(ewp.up, org.Hs.eg.db, keyType = "ENTREZID")
ewp.dn <- enrichWP(
  dn.genes.entrez[[2]],
  #universe = bkgd.genes[[2]], #hint: comment out to get any results for demo
  organism = "Homo sapiens",
  pAdjustMethod = "fdr",
  pvalueCutoff = 0.1, #p.adjust cutoff; relaxed for demo purposes
)
ewp.dn <- setReadable(ewp.dn, org.Hs.eg.db, keyType = "ENTREZID")
lc.pathways <- findPathwaysByText("lung cancer")
human.lc.pathways <- lc.pathways %>% dplyr::filter(species == "Homo sapiens")
lc.wpids <- human.lc.pathways$id
ewp.up.wpids <- ewp.up$ID
RCy3::commandsRun('wikipathways import-as-pathway id=WP179')
toggleGraphicsDetails()
loadTableData(lung.expr, data.key.column = "GeneID", table.key.column = "Ensembl")
setNodeColorMapping("log2FC", colors=paletteColorBrewerRdBu, style.name = "WikiPathways")
lapply(ewp.up.wpids[1:5], function (x) {
  commandsRun(paste0('wikipathways import-as-pathway id=',x))
  loadTableData(lung.expr, data.key.column = "GeneID", table.key.column = "Ensembl")
  toggleGraphicsDetails()
})
commandsRun('wikipathways import-as-network id=WP179')
loadTableData(lung.expr, data.key.column = "GeneID", table.key.column = "Ensembl")
unzip(system.file("extdata","drugbank-5.1.0.xgmml.zip", package="rWikiPathways"), exdir = getwd())
drugbank <- file.path(getwd(), "drugbank-5.1.0.xgmml")
commandsRun(paste0('cytargetlinker extend idAttribute="Ensembl" linkSetFiles="', drugbank, '"') )
commandsRun('cytargetlinker applyLayout network="current"')
my.drugs <- selectNodes("drug", by.col = "CTL.Type", preserve = FALSE)$nodes
clearSelection()
setNodeColorBypass(my.drugs, "#DD99FF")
setNodeShapeBypass(my.drugs, "hexagon")
drug.labels <- getTableColumns(columns=c("SUID","CTL.label"))
drug.labels <- na.omit(drug.labels)
mapply(function(x,y) setNodeLabelBypass(x,y), drug.labels$SUID, drug.labels$CTL.label)
save(ewp.up, file = "lung_cancer_ewp_up.Rdata")
save(ewp.dn, file = "lung_cancer_ewp_down.Rdata")
saveSession('tutorial_session')
exportImage('tutorial_image2', type='PDF')
exportImage('tutorial_image2', type='PNG', zoom=200)

workflows.name: pathway_gene_set_enrichment_analysis
workflows.intent: Perform Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (GSEA) on a ranked list of genes using WikiPathways.
input: data-lung-cancer.csv (differential gene expression dataset containing Ensembl IDs, log2 fold changes, and p-values)
workflows.stages:
1. Load differential expression data and convert background gene identifiers to Entrez IDs.
2. Calculate a ranking metric (e.g., based on log2 fold change and p-value) for each gene.
3. Merge the ranking metric with the converted Entrez IDs and sort the list in descending order.
4. Run GSEA against WikiPathways using clusterProfiler::gseWP.
5. Extract and filter pathways enriched for up-regulated or down-regulated genes.
workflows.code:
lung.expr <- read.csv(system.file("extdata","data-lung-cancer.csv", package="rWikiPathways"),stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
bkgd.genes <- lung.expr[,1]
bkgd.genes.entrez <- bitr(bkgd.genes,fromType = "ENSEMBL",toType = "ENTREZID",OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)
lung.expr$fcsign <- sign(lung.expr$log2FC)
lung.expr$logfdr <- -log10(lung.expr$P.Value)
lung.expr$sig <- lung.expr$logfdr/lung.expr$fcsign
sig.lung.expr.entrez<-merge(lung.expr, bkgd.genes.entrez, by.x = "GeneID", by.y = "ENSEMBL")
gsea.sig.lung.expr <- sig.lung.expr.entrez[,8]
names(gsea.sig.lung.expr) <- as.character(sig.lung.expr.entrez[,9])
gsea.sig.lung.expr <- sort(gsea.sig.lung.expr,decreasing = TRUE)
gwp.sig.lung.expr <- clusterProfiler::gseWP(
  gsea.sig.lung.expr,
  pAdjustMethod = "fdr",
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05, #p.adjust cutoff
  organism = "Homo sapiens"
)
gwp.sig.lung.expr.df = as.data.frame(gwp.sig.lung.expr)
gwp.sig.lung.expr.df[which(gwp.sig.lung.expr.df$NES > 1),] #pathways enriched for upregulated lung cancer genes
gwp.sig.lung.expr.df[which(gwp.sig.lung.expr.df$NES < -1),] #pathways enriched for downregulated lung cancer genes
